name: Group photo frame
summary: A photo frame with everyone's silhouette: tap the days you're around and you step into the frame, the one day all of you are free lights it up, and the frame sets a reminder to take the photo that night.
useWhen: we have no group photo from this year
when are all 6 of us around to take a pic
need one photo of everyone before break
formal is the only night we're all here right?
let's finally get a group pic, what day works
dontUseWhen: picking a time for a meeting or study session (use meeting-time)
voting on what to do, not when (use plan-spinner)
an album of photos you already took (use album)

post.description: Who posted it and what they said

people.description: Everyone who should be in the photo, by first name (up to 10)

label.description: What's on that night, e.g. 'formal'; empty if nothing

free.description: Who is already free and in town that day

remindAt.description: When the reminder goes off that day, e.g. '8pm'
